description:
This season quietly became one of the strongest new anime lineups in years — so here are the Top 10 new anime you can't skip, fully ranked. From The Apothecary Diaries and the long-awaited return of Black Clover to Firefly Wedding, Overgeared, Psyren and more, every must-watch new anime is broken down below.

10 Anime That Are About to Take Over Your Watchlist, Whether you're into isekai, battle shonen, mystery or romance, one of these is about to become your next obsession. Full ranked list and timestamps below 👇

💬 How many were already on your list — and which one jumped straight onto it? And which show did I leave off that people should riot about? Drop it in the comments.
